verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows ClickUp has a Public API for reading/writing tasks, comments, views, etc. (clickup-docs-28/33/34) and mentions an OpenAPI spec, but the openapi.json endpoint 404s in the probe (clickup-probe-2), and there is no documentation of a bulk 'export all your data' feature, data-portability guarantee, or open-format (CSV/JSON/Markdown) full-workspace export/leave mechanism. Community evidence is about product quality/UX, not data export.
